metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Subhendra Basu (bosons14): EDA, code review, plain-English maths, AI learning and a compassionate listener.

plugins.name: eda-ops
plugins.description: EDA toolkit: RTL lint/review, CDC, Yosys QoR, self-checking simulation, formal verification, OpenSTA timing, SDC/XDC review, EDA log triage and EDA docs search.

plugins.name: codereview-ops
plugins.description: Language-agnostic code review: scoped diffs, linter evidence, parallel independent reviewers, verified findings, security audit, SARIF/CI output.

plugins.name: plainproof
plugins.description: Ask number questions in plain English; Claude tests them locally, then Harmonic's Aristotle proves or refutes them, explained without jargon.

plugins.name: bosontube
plugins.description: Curated free AI, ML and Gen AI courses on YouTube, with learning paths and progress tracking.

plugins.name: listener
plugins.description: An ELIZA-inspired compassionate listener. A comforting presence, not a therapist — with built-in crisis detection that surfaces helplines and guides safety steps.
